items.why_en: Kunlun Wanwei released Matrix-Game 3.5, focusing on interactive world model technology with patch-level memory injection and system-level performance optimization, highly significant for interactive world generation in game module creation.

items.name: Tripo AI AniGen
items.why: 作為 Tripo AI 第三季開源發布的一部分，AniGen 能夠從單一圖像生成可動畫的 3D 資產，包括幾何體、紋理、骨架和蒙皮，對遊戲角色和動畫資產生成至關重要。
items.why_en: As part of Tripo AI's third season of open-source releases, AniGen generates animatable 3D assets including geometry, texture, skeleton, and skinning from a single image, crucial for game character and animation asset generation.

items.name: Rodin Gen-2.5
items.why: Rodin Gen-2.5 提供了雕塑級的細節和生產控制，改進了速度、細節、紋理一致性和拓撲選項，適用於可擴展的 3D 資產生產。
items.why_en: Rodin Gen-2.5 offers sculpt-level detail and production control, improving speed, detail, texture consistency, and topology options for scalable 3D asset production.

items.name: Meshy-6
items.why: Meshy-6 雖然於今年初發布，但在 2026 年 7 月的評測中仍被廣泛提及為 Meshy 最新的核心 AI 模型，為其圖像轉 3D 工具提供動力，並在持續的產品更新中扮演核心角色。
items.why_en: Although released earlier this year, Meshy-6 is widely cited in July 2026 reviews as Meshy's latest core AI model powering its image-to-3D tool and playing a central role in ongoing product updates.

items.why_en: Flow Studio's AI rigging capabilities received significant enhancements, particularly with Maya scene export improvements, Human IK support, and more granular animation control sliders.

items.why_en: Meshy officially released its Auto-rigging & Animation API, allowing developers to more easily integrate its AI 3D generation and animation capabilities into their applications.

items.name: Houdini 22 (KineFX Updates)
items.why: Houdini 22 帶來了 KineFX 綁骨與動畫工具集的重大更新,並新增了直接綁骨、動畫和渲染 3D Gaussian Splats 的能力。
items.why_en: Houdini 22 introduced major updates to its KineFX rigging and animation toolset, including new capabilities to rig, animate, and render 3D Gaussian Splats directly within Houdini.

items.name: Krikey AI Animation Generator
items.why: Krikey AI 發佈了先進的 3D 動畫工具,旨在透過文字提示和動畫模板自動生成高擬真 3D 角色動畫,解決綁骨和關鍵幀的繁瑣流程。
items.why_en: Krikey AI unveiled advanced 3D animation tools designed to automatically generate high-fidelity 3D character animations from text prompts and animation templates, addressing tedious rigging and keyframing workflows.

items.name: Tripo Auto-Rigging (Animate rig model)

items.why_en: Tripo AI updated its rigging model version from v2.0 to v2.5 in June, improving the performance and results of its auto-rigging capabilities.
